description: The 2019 General Election is in 2 phases. The first one, which is on the national level and includes the Presidential and National Assembly elections will hold on Saturday, 16th February, 2019. The second one, which on the state level and includes the Governorship and State Assemblies elections will hold on Saturday, 2nd March, 2019.
